title: Sequin Lace Chiffon Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at any wedding with this stunning sleeveless chiffon dress! Adorned with shimmering sequins, it features a flattering A-line silhouette and a flowy, lightweight design that moves gracefully. Perfect for dancing the night away in effortless elegance!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
